summary: STEP 6 (Final Wiring) testing — Backend 73/73 GREEN (19/19 new tests for STEP 6 PoD + updated staff-pin contract; 54/54 regression). Frontend 4/5 critical flows GREEN. Verified: (1) StaffPinGate 2-step 6-tile picker → PIN input → unlock end-to-end with sessionStorage populated correctly (staff_pin_ok=true, id, name='Erfa', role='Kasir'). (2) Production Scanner /production: clicking WASH station fires PATCH /api/orders/LND-024/status with actor (success toast shown). (3) Courier Antareun tab shows 3 Menunggu di Outlet + 5 Di Atas Motor (backend shows packing=4, otw=4 after seed, matches after initial manifest offset). (4) Courier SCAN BARANG MASUK MOTOR → PATCH /api/orders/LND-006/status succeeded (toast 'Order LND-006 masuk motor · Sedang Diantar · oleh Erfa' confirms actor='Erfa' from sessionStorage is wired through). (5) POS click-save-create-order NOT verified via UI because the save button is gated by 'Upload bukti pembayaran dulu' — default paymentStatus appears to be 'lunas' and payment-nanti toggle did not reliably deselect Lunas across 3 attempts. Backend endpoint itself (POST /api/orders) is fully covered by 5 order tests in existing regression suite.

integration_issues.issue: Default paymentStatus seems to be 'lunas' which blocks save until a payment-proof photo is uploaded. Clicking [data-testid=payment-nanti] did not clear the 'Upload bukti pembayaran dulu' blocker — either the toggle needs double-click, or the initial state starts as lunas with the blocker. Tested 3 times with various fill strategies. Not a regression (pre-existing UX guard), but the test couldn't verify the fire-and-forget createOrder path via UI. Backend createOrder is proven independently (test_orders_seed.py green).

action_items: (OPTIONAL) Main agent may want to verify the POS payment-toggle default — if default state truly is 'lunas', consider flipping to 'nanti' OR make payment-nanti click idempotent even when already selected (so automation can force-set state).
(OPTIONAL) The Tamel Pickup manifest on /courier remains an in-memory mock per PRD — main agent already flagged this. No action needed for STEP 6.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/orders/{order_id}/pod endpoint is well-implemented: proper 404/415/400/413 error ladder, uses UploadFile correctly, writes to uploads/pod/ under Path(__file__), filename includes order_id+kind+uuid for uniqueness, static serving verified through K8s ingress (GET $BASE/api/uploads/pod/<fname> returns 200 image/png).

order_events appended from the PoD endpoint include extra 'kind' and 'pod_url' fields which are NOT part of the OrderEvent pydantic model (extra='ignore'). This works for storage/read but means these tags won't surface in Order responses — acceptable since the canonical url list is in pod_urls. Worth a code comment for future devs.

StaffPinRequest breaking change handled correctly: pin_code pattern r'^\d{4}$' + staff_id min_length=1. /auth/staff-pin mismatched staff_id+pin returns same 'PIN salah' 403 (no user enumeration leak — good security posture).
POS handleSave is fire-and-forget per spec — even if backend returns 409 duplicate, receipt modal pops. LGTM but hard to surface silent failures. Consider logging to console for debugging.
sessionStorage keys staff_pin_ok/id/name/role are set atomically by StaffPinGate — no partial-state risk. Gate correctly re-appears only if ok is missing.

ProductionScanner/CourierDashboard correctly fetch fresh candidate order before PATCH (no stale client-side state), and use actor tag from sessionStorage via getActorTag() — verified by toast 'oleh Erfa' on courier scan.
